verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is a secrets-scanning product with an enterprise web UI, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence shows AI- or LLM-generated insights or suggestions. Its Analyze feature and verification are rule- and request-based secret metadata analysis, a related but different capability that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
